concerns.text: FR-001 mandates ingestion of raw text transcripts to enable lexical and syntactic feature extraction, while FR-002 specifies analysis of lexical (e.g., TTR, MTLD) and syntactic (e.g., Mean Clause Length) markers. The current specification provides no contingency if raw transcripts are unavailable (as noted in the unresolved panel concerns). Without raw transcripts the study cannot compute the majority of the declared linguistic features, so the methodology will not be able to answer the research question as stated. A formal amendment or alternative data source is required before the analysis can proceed.
